newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso mixed in dull trade ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso mixed in dull trade ahead of FOMC.

text.p: The Mexican peso was mixed in dull mid-morning trade on Monday, with dealers mostly on the sidelines ahead of Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
"The market is really dead, basically we are waiting for tomorrow's (FOMC) news," a trader said. "Dealers are just gazing at the market."
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart both stood 0.3 of a centavo firmer at 7.8900/7.8930 and 7.8875/7.8900 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed 0.3 centavo weaker at 7.8850/7.8870 per dollar.
